additions.reason: This verse (Psalms 112:10) is explicitly called the bechina of the angels searching for lost things (para 9: 'המלאכים המחפשים אחר האבדות, שהם בחינת תאוות רשעים תאבד'). It serves as the dual-domain node: as a verse it belongs to Package 1 (the recovery system reads its acronym as TRT), while the desire it condemns belongs to Package 2.
additions.source_quote: וְזֶה: תַּאֲוַת רְשָׁעִים תֹּאבֵד – רָאשֵׁי תֵבוֹת: תְּקִיעָה, תְּרוּעָה, תְּקִיעָה, כִּי הַמַּלְאָכִים הַמְחַפְּשִׂים אַחַר הָאֲבֵדוֹת, שֶׁהֵם בְּחִינַת תַּאֲוַת רְשָׁעִים תֹּאבֵד, הֵם אוֹחֲזִים בְּיָדָם שׁוֹפָרוֹת וְתוֹקְעִים תַּרַ"ת

additions.reason: Para 11 explicitly states that the kavanot of Elul are 'תיקון לפגם הברית' and that this, the fruits section, and the angel section are all 'הכל אחד'. Elul kavanot belong to the same domain as בְּרָכָה and יִרְאַת שָׁמַיִם — they are all forms of conscious, intentional divine awareness that protect and rectify.
additions.source_quote: עִנְיַן כַּוָּנַת אֱלוּל, שֶׁהֵם תִּקּוּן לִפְגַם הַבְּרִית, וְעִנְיַן הַפֵּרוֹת הַנַּ"ל, וְעִנְיָן זֶה שֶׁל הַמַּלְאָךְ וְכוּ' כַּנַּ"ל – הַכֹּל אֶחָד

additions.reason: The tikkun for the blemish of the covenant (brit) is mentioned in para 11 as the overarching purpose to which the Elul kavanot belong. Pgam habrit (blemish of the sexual covenant) is classically connected to taavah — desire — making this tikkun the positive counter to Package 2's taavah-domain. The tikkun belongs in Package 3 as the full rectification achieved through mindful avodah.
additions.source_quote: עִנְיַן כַּוָּנַת אֱלוּל, שֶׁהֵם תִּקּוּן לִפְגַם הַבְּרִית

additions.reason: The blemish of the covenant (pgam habrit) is the underlying evil that requires tikkun. It is in the same domain as taavah — indeed the primary taavah that causes spiritual loss. The Rebbe's connection of pgam habrit to Elul tikkun implies the fruit-desire (eating before ripeness) is an expression of the same domain as sexual taavah (both draw from the wrong place at the wrong time).
additions.source_quote: עִנְיַן כַּוָּנַת אֱלוּל, שֶׁהֵם תִּקּוּן לִפְגַם הַבְּרִית

additions.reason: Para 10 notes that the Rebbe mentioned 'jealousy of scribes increases wisdom' (B.B. 21) in connection with this Torah, without explaining it. The scribe notes it was forgotten. This concept — competitive scholarly zeal that produces wisdom — seems connected to the recovery domain: wisdom is found (recovered) through the zeal/competition of learners. It belongs tentatively in Package 1 (the recovery/finding domain) though the connection is sealed and not fully explained.
additions.source_quote: וְגַם הִזְכִּיר אָז קִנְאַת סוֹפְרִים תַּרְבֶּה חָכְמָה (ב"ב כא). וְלֹא בֵּאֵר כָּל זֶה, כִּי הֵם דְּבָרִים סְתוּמִים וַחֲתוּמִים
additions.uncertainty_note: The connection is explicitly stated as sealed and partially forgotten. This assignment to Package 1 is tentative. It may belong in a separate package or in a larger teaching that was lost.

additions.reason: Para 10 also mentions that the Rebbe noted 'it is very very difficult to be a receiver (mekabel)'. Being a proper receiver — of teaching, of holiness, of the tzaddik's influence — is connected to the domain of careful intentionality and readiness. Like a fruit that must be properly ripened before it can be received/eaten, a person must be ready before receiving. This belongs in the brachah/kavanah domain (Package 3) as the spiritual state of proper receptivity.
additions.source_quote: וְגַם הִזְכִּיר אָז, שֶׁקָּשֶׁה מְאֹד מְאֹד לִהְיוֹת מְקַבֵּל
additions.uncertainty_note: Mentioned without explanation. The Rebbe himself did not develop this point in the surviving text. Assignment is tentative based on the fruit-readiness metaphor running through the Torah.

analysis_notes.note_on_sealed_content: Para 10 explicitly states that the Rebbe did not explain much of this Torah because 'הם דברים סתומים וחתומים' (they are sealed and closed matters), and that some content was forgotten because it was not written at the time. This means the gap analysis is fundamentally incomplete — portions of the teaching that would clarify the bechina structure were intentionally withheld or accidentally lost. The additions above represent the recoverable concepts; an unknown number of additional concepts were sealed or forgotten.
analysis_notes.good_evil_mirror_analysis: Package 1 (angel-shofar recovery) mirrors Package 2 (taavah-loss): the same word אֲבֵדוֹת appears in both — in Package 2, taavah CAUSES the אבדות; in Package 1, the angel FINDS the אבדות. Package 3 (brachah/yirah) is the practical counter to Package 2 at the human level. Package 4 (fruit/koach hamoshekh) is the neutral structural domain that both sides operate through.
